Meta-analysis physiological costs of hibernation: Report 6 - GC Arousal

Pablo Capilla-Lasheras

2026-05-04

This R Markdown Notebook contains the initial meta-analysis for the project ‘physiological ’costs’ of hibernation. Specifically, the meta-analysis of arousal.

Dataset and calculation of effect sizes

The dataset for this meta-analysis has been collected from the literature and curated by Pablo Burraco, Marko Prokic and Tamara Petrovic. It contains data on physiological effects of hibernation in different systems. Here a quick snapshot of the first lines of the dataset:

# dataset with raw data
data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(
  here(
    "./01_data/raw_data/Burraco_et_al_hibernation_arousal.xlsx"
  ),
  colNames = T,
  sheet = 3
)

paged_table(data, options = list(rows.print = 20))

As a summary of the initial dataset:

  • Number of studies: 18
  • Number of species: 15

For this initial meta-analysis, I am going to include all immune (IM) markers and calculate the standarised mean difference (g; with heteroscedastic population variances) as the effect size of analysis comparing arousal versus euthermia. Positive SMD values indicate higher OS values in arousal while negative SMD indicate lower OS values in arousal. This is a summary of the effect size calculation based on the dataset above:

# ES data
data <- readRDS(
  here(
    "./01_data/processed_RDS_data_files/06_GC_metaanalysis_arousal_full_data.RDS"
  )
)
data$obsID <- 1:nrow(data) # observation ID


data$scientific_name <- gsub(
  x = data$Species,
  pattern = "_",
  replacement = " "
)

data$scientific_name_phylo <- data$scientific_name

## data for SMD
df_SMD <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH.sv))

# matrix with phylogentic correlations
phylo_cor <- readRDS(
  here(
    "./01_data/processed_RDS_data_files/06_GC_phylogenetic_correlations_arousal.RDS"
  )
)

phylo_tree <- readRDS(
  here(
    "./01_data/processed_RDS_data_files/06_GC_phylogenetic_tree_arousal.RDS"
  )
)

tree <- ggtree(phylo_tree, size = 1.2) +
  xlim_tree(c(0, 35)) +
  geom_tiplab(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        "italic('",
        sub(x = label, pattern = "_", replacement = " "),
        "')"
      )
    ),
    parse = TRUE,
    offset = 0.5,
    size = 5,
    hjust = 0
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "./03_plots/02_arousal/00c_GC_phylo_tree_arousal.png"
  ),
  plot = tree,
  device = "png",
  height = 150,
  width = 90,
  units = "mm"
)

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "./03_plots/02_arousal/00c_GC_phylo_tree_arousal.pdf"
  ),
  plot = tree,
  height = 150,
  width = 90,
  units = "mm"
)

Summary of SMD effect size and number of observations included in the meta-analysis:

summary(df_SMD$SMDH)
##     Min.  1st Qu.   Median     Mean  3rd Qu.     Max. 
## -2.76323 -1.05404 -0.35289 -0.03781  0.79233  4.16865
print(tree)

  • Number of observation with non-missing SMD: 28
  • Number of studies in the dataset for analysis: 6
  • Number of species in the dataset for analysis: 5

Initial meta-analysis:

## calculate var-cover matrix to control for correlated effect sizes within study and tissue
V <- vcalc(
  vi = SMDH.sv,
  cluster = StudyID,
  subgroup = Tissue,
  grp1 = Arousal_M,
  grp2 = Euthermia_M,
  w1 = Arousal_N,
  w2 = Euthermia_N,
  data = df_SMD
)

# model
model_SMD <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V,
  mods = ~1,
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD,
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/01c_metamodel_hibernation_GC.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/01c_metamodel_hibernation_GC.RDS'
  )
)
summary(model_SMD)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 28; method: REML)
## 
##   logLik  Deviance       AIC       BIC      AICc   
## -48.1162   96.2325  106.2325  112.7116  109.0896   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed                 factor    R 
## sigma^2.1  0.0000  0.0029      5     no  scientific_name_phylo  yes 
## sigma^2.2  0.0000  0.0026      5     no                Species   no 
## sigma^2.3  1.3065  1.1430     28     no                  obsID   no 
## sigma^2.4  0.0000  0.0021      6     no                StudyID   no 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 27) = 125.8157, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub    
##  -0.3083  0.2917  -1.0570  0.2905  -0.8800  0.2634    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
i2_SMD <- round(i2_ml(model_SMD), digits = 4) # heterogeneity random effects

Proportion of variation left after accounting for sampling variance and proportion accounted by each random effect:

knitr::kable(
  x = data.frame(
    Variable = names(i2_SMD),
    i2_value_percentage = as.numeric(round(i2_SMD, digits = 3))
  )
) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = F)

Plot of results of intercept-only model:

overall_plot <- orchard_plot(
  object = model_SMD,
  mod = "1",
  group = 'StudyID',
  k.pos = 2,
  trunk.size = 1,
  alpha = 0.2,
  cb = FALSE,
  xlab = "Standardised Mean Difference",
  transfm = "none"
) +
  scale_fill_okabe_ito() +
  scale_color_okabe_ito() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, angle = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-3, 3),
    breaks = seq(-3, 3, 1),
    label = seq(-3, 3, 1)
  )

Publication bias: small-study effects

df_SMD$inv_eff_ss <- (1 / df_SMD$Arousal_N) + (1 / df_SMD$Euthermia_N)

model_SMD_pb <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V,
  mods = ~ 1 + sqrt(inv_eff_ss),
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD_pb,
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/06c_pb_metamodel_hibernation_GC.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD_pb <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/06c_pb_metamodel_hibernation_GC.RDS'
  )
)

summary(model_SMD_pb)

Publication bias: time-lag effects

df_SMD$year_scl <- scale(df_SMD$Year)

model_SMD_tl <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V,
  mods = ~ 1 + year_scl,
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD_tl,
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/07c_timelag_metamodel_hibernation_GC.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD_tl <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/07c_timelag_metamodel_hibernation_GC.RDS'
  )
)

summary(model_SMD_tl)

Meta-analysis including thermoregulation type as a moderator:

Number of observations for each type:

table(df_SMD$Thermoregulation)
## 
## Ectotherm Endotherm 
##        20         8
model_SMD_thermoregulation <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V,
  mods = ~ Thermoregulation - 1,
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS", nearpd = TRUE),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD_thermoregulation,
  file = here(
    './04_models/02_arousal/03c_metareg_thermoregulation_hibernation_GC.RDS'

)

)
